name: groupagg
title: per-group sum, sum of squares and count over positional keys (aggregate-only GROUP BY)
expected_llvm_reason: positional group_keys / group_by / ragged peels are in the LLVM lane (2026-10), and the aggregate-only one pass (round 3 W3-1, gap G71) is placed by both lanes

hypothesis.natural: WIN (the natural tier is O(n * ngroups) masked intrinsics)
hypothesis.expert: repro: parity or a small loss (both one pass over the rows; Blade adds the key-guard and the record copy-out); licensed: LOSS (Blade keeps the CSR + gather + K-lane peels because the per-group folds are licensed float folds, gap G71)

notes: Serial only. The per-group chains are independent, so a threaded form exists in principle (privatized per-thread accumulators and an ordered combine), but it is a different association and Blade v1 has no thread form -- no mt8 arm in any language. The default (licensed) Blade build DECLINES the one pass (its folds are licensed builtin `+` folds; BLADE_GROUP_AGG=licensed takes the ascending chain instead, an association change); BLADE_FP_REPRO=1 takes it. Named outputs: s, q, c (stored in every arm). Input share ~45% (the generator runs twice over n). The natural tier is O(n * ngroups): ~3e9 element tests at full size, expected seconds.
